Live, always-on virtual receptionist support
A ringing phone can be more than an interruption. It can be a new lead, a returning customer, or someone who needs an answer right now. Ruby’s live virtual receptionists help make sure those conversations don’t end in voicemail just because you’re with a client, finishing a job, or done for the day.
When a call routes to Ruby, a trained receptionist—not a bot—answers on your behalf. Coverage is available 24/7, including weekends and holidays, and you decide when Ruby steps in. We can answer every call, cover selected calls, or serve as backup when your team is unavailable.
Ruby receptionists can answer common questions, capture leads, schedule appointments, and connect callers according to your preferences. With managed live chat , real people can also engage website visitors and help capture opportunities.
Whether you’re a law firm, home services company, or small office, Ruby helps you stay responsive without staffing the phones around the clock. Explore businesses across industries or get started with Ruby .
Ruby FAQs
What is a virtual receptionist?
A virtual receptionist is a real person who answers calls on behalf of your business. Ruby’s receptionists can greet callers, answer frequently asked questions, capture lead information, schedule appointments, collect payments, connect calls and more according to your business’s preferences.
The goal isn’t simply to take a message. It’s to help resolve more of the caller’s needs during that first conversation whenever possible, while making sure they feel cared for from the first hello.
How much does a virtual receptionist cost?
Cost depends on the amount of receptionist time your business needs. Ruby offers plans based on monthly receptionist minutes, so a solo business and a growing team don’t have to purchase the same amount of coverage.
When comparing providers, look beyond the base rate and ask what may cost extra, including holiday coverage, bilingual answering, appointment scheduling, integrations, and setup. You can review Ruby’s plans and pricing to compare options and included features.
Are Ruby's virtual receptionists bilingual?
Yes. Ruby offers English-Spanish call handling with a bilingual virtual receptionist available 24/7. That gives Spanish-speaking and English-speaking callers the opportunity to speak with a real person rather than navigate an automated phone experience.
Does Ruby use AI or live receptionists?
Ruby uses live, human receptionists. An AI virtual receptionist that independently picks up and conducts the call isn’t how Ruby works. Instead, Ruby uses AI to support parts of the experience behind the scenes, including tools such as transcripts and AI-assisted call flows. The person speaking with your caller remains a trained human receptionist.
What's the difference between a virtual receptionist and basic call answering?
Basic call answering may end with taking a caller’s information or passing along a message. Ruby’s receptionists can do more during the conversation. Depending on your preferences, they can answer common questions, capture leads, schedule appointments, collect payments, and connect callers to you or another number. The goal is to help the caller accomplish more during the first interaction while reducing the administrative work that lands back on your team. In other words, the value isn’t just that someone picked up. It’s what they can help your caller accomplish once they do.

Free & Starter Zapier Plans: every 15 minutes
Professional Zapier Plan: every two minutes

Create new contacts in your CRM, mailing list, or contact list.
Get new message notifications sent to members of your team.
Add callers to email campaigns based on conditions they meet after calls are completed.
Generate forms and automatically send them to callers to your analytics software for tracking and analysis.
Send call data to your analytics software for tracking and analysis.

Help more clients with an immigration law receptionist service.
By
Matt Lurie
The job of an immigration attorney often goes beyond legal counsel. It involves providing hope and guidance during one of the most stressful periods in a client’s life. You entered this field to make a difference, to help families stay together, and to provide pathways to new opportunities. But the very passion that drives can also lead to overwhelming caseloads and the constant pressure to be available for every client in need.
As the demand for immigration services continues to grow , many attorneys find themselves stretched thin . The administrative tasks required to run a practice can quickly consume the hours you’d rather spend on casework. If you’re feeling the strain of an ever-growing to-do list, it might be time to explore how an answering service can help you reclaim your time, reduce stress, and ultimately, more effectively serve your clients.
The unique challenges of immigration law
Working in immigration law comes with a distinct set of challenges . Your clients often face significant uncertainty and anxiety, relying on you for timely updates and reassurance. This creates an environment where constant communication is not just expected but essential for client well-being.
Between court dates, paperwork, and client consultations, managing incoming calls can feel like a full-time job. Missed calls can mean missed opportunities to help someone new or a delay in assisting an existing client. This pressure contributes to attorney burnout , a significant issue that can impact both your professional effectiveness and personal health. Finding a sustainable way to manage your practice is key to providing the high level of care your clients deserve.
Save time, win opportunities, & optimize client communication with a receptionist service.
An answering service acts as a seamless extension of your firm, handling a wide range of administrative tasks letting you focus on what you do best: practicing law. By entrusting your communications to a team of professional receptionists, you can ensure that every call is answered promptly and compassionately, even when you’re in court or meeting with a client.
Let’s explore a few concrete ways an answering service like Ruby can help you serve more clients and build a more efficient practice.
1. Perfect your client intake process.
First impressions matter, especially when a potential client is reaching out for help. A warm, professional, and empathetic voice on the other end of the line can make all the difference. Our virtual receptionists are trained to handle client intake with care, gathering essential information so you have everything you need before the initial consultation. This ensures you are fully prepared and can make the most of your time with each new person you help.
2. Qualify leads to focus on the right cases.
Not every inquiry will be the right fit for your practice. A virtual receptionist can ask qualifying questions based on your specific criteria, such as case type or geographic location. This pre-screening process saves you valuable time by filtering inquiries, allowing you to dedicate your energy to the clients you are best equipped to serve. You can work more efficiently, knowing that the consultations on your calendar are with individuals you can genuinely assist.
3. Schedule appointments and consultations with ease.
Coordinating schedules can be a time-consuming back-and-forth. An answering service can integrate directly with your calendar to book appointments and consultations seamlessly . When a potential client calls, our receptionists can view your availability and schedule them on the spot. This eliminates phone tag and administrative delays, creating a smooth and professional experience for your clients from their very first interaction with your firm.
4. Provide timely status updates and essential information.
Clients in immigration cases are often anxious for updates. While you can’t be available for every call, a virtual receptionist can. Provide us with answers to frequently asked questions or protocols for relaying basic, non-confidential case status information, and we can handle frontline communication . This simple step can provide immense comfort to clients, reduce their anxiety, and free you from handling routine update calls, allowing you to focus on more complex legal work.
5. Delegate the calls you need to make.
Your administrative tasks aren’t limited to incoming calls. A virtual receptionist service can also make outbound calls on your behalf . This can include confirming appointments, following up with potential clients who filled out a web form, or relaying simple messages. Offloading these tasks ensures your firm remains proactive and responsive without adding to your personal workload.
Ruby means achieving more for your clients.
Imagine what you could accomplish with more time in your day. Ruby’s customers consistently report saving ten or more hours each week after starting service.
How many more families could you help with that extra time?
How much more prepared and focused would you feel for each case?
Partnering with a receptionist service is an investment in your practice and your well-being. It allows you to provide the compassionate, attentive service your clients need while protecting you from burnout. By delegating administrative tasks, you can focus on your passion for the law and the meaningful work of helping people navigate their immigration journey.
Ready to build a more sustainable and impactful law practice?

Taking into account the nature of the personal information and purposes of processing the personal information, you have the right to request that we correct inaccurate personal information about you, if applicable.
Right to Limit Use and Disclosure of Sensitive Personal Information
If we process Sensitive Personal Information, we will only do so for the purposes specifically authorized by California law and in a manner that is necessary and proportionate for those purposes. As such, we do not perform any processing for which a Right to Limit request is available.
Submitting Requests
You can submit your request by emailing us at https://my.datasubject.com/16CVvZSmPFx0VPvo9/25350 or by toll-free phone at 1-800-207-7920
Verifying Requests
To ensure the protection of your personal information, we must verify that the individual submitting a request to know, request to delete, or request to correct is the consumer to whom the request relates prior to processing the request. To verify a California consumer’s identity, we may request up to three pieces of personal information about you when you make a request to compare against our records. We may also request that you sign a declaration under the penalty of perjury from the consumer whose personal information is the subject of the request.
Making a verifiable consumer request does not require you to create an account with us.
We will only use personal information provided in your request to verify your identity and will delete any information you provide after processing the request. We reserve the right to take additional steps as necessary to verify the identity of California consumers where we have reason to believe a request is fraudulent.
Authorized Agents
You may choose a person or a business registered with the California Secretary of State that you authorize to act on your behalf to submit your requests (“Authorized Agent”). If you choose to use an Authorized Agent, we require that you provide the Authorized Agent with written permission to allow them to submit your request and that you verify your identity directly with us. Failure to do so may result in RUBY denying your request.
